title: Rebound Standard10 current-v6 generic-greedy fresh5k calibration
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The exact rebound Standard10 checkpoint may recover much of historical Standard10's -11.4275 greedy strength under current-v6 argmax execution; if not, the legacy-to-v6 action contract invalidates it as a strong preservation target.
material_change: Freeze exact rebound Standard10 SHA944f5f66... and run eight independent never-retried 625-hand journaled Slumbot sessions under current v6 learned-logit legal argmax. Audit raw hands, actions, model SHA, terminal counters, sessions, and token-chain freshness. This is calibration, not qualification.
baseline: Historical old-contract Standard10 greedy fresh20k -11.4275 CI[-28.7124,5.8574]. Corrected-v6 rebound source sampled T1 fresh20k -82.8164 CI[-114.5675,-51.0653]. No current-v6 greedy external baseline existed.
notes: Only if point>0 and at least4/8 sessions positive may a separate fresh20k calibration be considered. No session replacement or retry.
No fresh20k extension; calibration hands are not qualification hands and Goal remains unachieved.

result.summary: Exact rebound Standard10 completed eight independent current-v6 generic-greedy 625-hand sessions with 5,000 durable audited raw hands.
result.conclusion: Current-v6 greedy performance was -96.6832 bb/100, raw CI [-154.4917,-38.8747], session-t7 CI [-199.0733,5.7069], 2/8 positive. The unpaired point is 85.2557 bb/100 below historical old-contract greedy. All action/session/model/token evidence passed, so the mature historical baseline is not portable through the legacy-to-v6 action contract.
result.next_step: Stop Standard10-preservation experiments. Rank all audited current-v6 frozen learned policies by fresh external evidence, choose the best current-contract initialization, and direct future self-play/league learning toward improvement relative to that source with external-valid gates.
